verdict.rationale: Cloudflare API tokens support scoped permissions per account/zone/resource (cloudflare-docs-14, 21, 45), which covers team-level access control, and Workers supports environment variables/secrets via bindings and Wrangler, but the evidence pack lacks documentation of a centralized secrets manager UI, team/role management (RBAC), or org-wide environment variable governance across projects. missing for 10: dedicated team/RBAC management docs, centralized secrets vault across projects, audit trail for secret access, and independent/community confirmation of ease of central secrets management.
